read_this_first: Run 5. ALL 130 MiniWoB++ pages with the code of commit cfbc9ff8: same browser, same search budget (600 actions), same success rule (the page's full reward), one try per instance, 20 instances per page. THE SCORED INSTANCES ARE SEEDS 1060-1079, WHICH NOBODY HAD LOOKED AT IN ANY WAY BEFORE THIS RUN (the pilot of the same day used 1040-1059; runs 3 and 4 used 1000-1039). No task is held out. WHAT CHANGED SINCE RUN 4, none of it written after looking at these instances: (1) a press lands on a part of the element that shows, not on the middle of its box whatever covers it; (2) the hand can also move the pointer onto an element, press three times fast, take hold of an element and let go of it over another, carry one a short way, and let the seconds the instruction speaks of go by, and the guided search tries those only after everything pressing and typing reach; (3) the instruction is read the way the benchmark's own environment reads it for an agent; (4) an element reports the colour the page states on it, and selected text is seen; (5) only a reset begins an episode (the new three-press action had produced a false success through the page's START cover; found and removed during the pilot, before any number was kept). RESULT: a first success was found on 78 of 130 pages (run 4: 69). Tasks at 18 of 20 or more: from one success 45 (run 4, on its own unseen instances 1020-1039: 34), with three practice instances 51 (38). Successes of 1560: 1097 and 1212. Controls on the same instances: random 2 tasks, replaying the demonstration 11, the tree's existing compiler 13, the one-success skill denied the instruction 12. Where replaying the demonstration is not enough: 34 from one success and 40 with practice, against 1 when denied the instruction. THE COMPARISON WITH RUN 4 IS ACROSS DIFFERENT INSTANCES OF THE SAME PAGES: the skills run 4 kept were lost with the sandbox and could not be scored on the new instances. Of the 11 pages newly at 18 of 20 from one success, 8 are pages the change was aimed at (button-delay, drag-box, highlight-text, highlight-text-2 need the new actions; click-color needs the instruction as the benchmark words it and the colour; click-button-sequence, click-test-2, click-test-transfer were hit by the press-point fault). The other 3 (form-sequence-3, use-autocomplete, use-autocomplete-nodelay) stood at 15 or 16 of 20 in run 4, nothing was aimed at them, and why they moved was not analysed: it may be where the press lands, or it may be the draw of instances. No page fell below 18 of 20. WHAT IS STILL NOT DONE BY THIS MACHINE: 51 pages have no first success within the budget; on 1 the first success does not happen again on a fresh page; and 27 pages have a first success but stay below 18 of 20 even with practice -- among them pages that ask for one thing in several ways, such as a menu of any depth (click-menu) and a list item dragged to a stated place (drag-items). ONE MEMORY (one_memory below): one agent holding every program run 5 kept, 124 programs from 78 pages, given pages and never the name of a task, same instances: 54 of 130 pages at 18 of 20 or more (run 4, on instances the producer had read: 46). With the page's own programs taken out: 34 (33), and of those 0 are pages that have no first success of their own -- what carries over is between variants of one task. Producer-run in a sandbox; nobody else has repeated it.
